sets.species: first things first, use your brain, if they lead some shit like steelceus or some shit like defog poisonceus, or if theyre good enough to judgment the lead arc instead of toxic it, don't be afraid to switch out. some mu's to know are listed below:
moves: click judgment. if they dd and don't die to orb recoil + judg, go marsh and revenge.
if it's primal, judgment once and then set rocks. origin pulse doesn't kill in one, spout doesn't kill if you judgment first. if it's regular kyogre just set rocks like a man.
if ur feeling shiesty click magic coat to catch rocks or toxic, if not just click sr. if they toxic on coat, spam the shit out of coat to deny rocks and get chip on don with toxic.

either click magic coat to catch toxic or go the other fairy arc/mewtwo to get burnt by sacred or refresh off a toxic. this is so good to get tox'd because you can 1v1 with mewtwo and the cm refresh fairy now. you dont wanna get the lead fairy statused bc then rocks are doomed to never go up.
click mcoat to catch taunt or sr. if they sr, judg after. if they click screens, click sr right after or spam mcoat as they sr till their light screen is on the last turn and then roar.
either mcoat or click sr. if they psycho boost on sr, judg after. if they taunt on mcoat, sr after and then judge. if you got the 50/50 wrong, be better.

this ones prediction reliant as fuck. click mcoat turn one. if they infestation, click mcoat until it runs out as they encore, and then judgment as they infestation again or win a 50/50 and coat again. you can also just force no webs or just webs on both sides if youre good enough, if they spam click rocks onto mcoat just click judge.
click judge as they fakeout/protect, sr or judge on the turn they switch out.

vs fairy arc, dark arc, water arc, click mcoat to catch a toxic. spam mcoat till theyre gonna take 25% from tox the next turn, judg after. vs groundceus normalceus, click sr and then roar if they set up. vs steelceus, switch to your own and then pray kek. vs poisonceus, switch into mewtwo. you can be a real 1 into darkceus and click judg or sr turn one but that's user discretion.
switch into steelceus and pray theyre not focus blast or psong, or sr if you read either of those as a set. lead mewtwo into mgar teams.

magic coat if you think theyre gonna click webs or spore, judg if you think theyre going to nuzzle(this is also webs), rocks after. if they click shell smash, choose between roaring on baton pass or magic coating on spore.
